newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST-Hanson pre-split profits seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Hanson pre-split profits seen down.

text.p: UK conglomerate Hanson Plc, which spun off its tobacco and chemicals companies on October 1, lays its past to rest next Thursday when it publishes the last set of results embracing all four units before the demergers go ahead.

The final results for the year to September 30 are released next Thursday and expected to show a decline from last year's pretax profits of 1.275 billion stg, after accounting for a 98 million pounds charge and exceptional gains of 339 million.
The concensus forecast is 1.21 billion. The range of forecasts are from 480 million to 1.8 billion pounds.
The year dividend is seen flat at 12.0 pence. The results will be the last to include the performance of the UK firm Imperial Tobacco Plc and Millennium Chemecals, floated in the U.S.
One analyst said of the results, "They are academic, reflecting the Hanson that was, not the Hanson that is."
The remaining parts of the group are the energy business, to be floated off early next year, and the building business, which will retain the Hanson name after demergers are completed.
Investors will await further news on demerger progress and a trading update for the remaining businesses.
The group's shares have seen strong activity on Friday, with nearly 10.5 million Hanson shares changing hands on vague bid rumours, dealers said.
